t: Carmax - What's Your Experience? — Car Forums at Edmunds.com
s: October 24, 2005 - As far as Carmax having the "best" quality used cars? t: How Does Buying From Carmax Actually Work? - Bogleheads.org
s: Carmax is typically higher than most anywhere else. The prices are non-negotiable but if you want a lower price, you can wait. They lower them about every 2 weeks or so.
